title: Crystallization of the quantum Stiefel manifolds $SO_q(2n+1)/SO_q(2n-1)$
summary: In this paper, we introduce the crystallization $C(SO_0(2n+1)/SO_0(2n-1))$ of the $C^*$-algebra $C(SO_q(2n+1)/SO_q(2n-1))$. We show that every irreducible representation of $C(SO_0(2n+1)/SO_0(2n-1))$ arises as the limit, as $q \to 0^+$, of a family of irreducible representations of $C(SO_q(2n+1)/SO_q(2n-1))$. As a consequence, we prove that $C(SO_0(2n+1)/SO_0(2n-1))$ is the universal $C^*$-algebra generated by a finite set of generators and relations.
